title: Runs
subtitle: One tool's calls to the model, end to end, as a waterfall: where the time went, call by call, and what each call sent and got back. Click any row; every row has its own link.
empty: No runs yet. Runs are drawn from the calls the Live page records: point a tool at the observe port and let it work.
emptyLink: Open Live to set that up

facts.outside: Time in tools and the agent

finding.load: {seconds} s loading the model: it was not in memory. That is {share}% of the whole run.
finding.empty: The cache was empty {n} times on a prompt worth keeping: the agent started a fresh conversation, or changed the start of its prompt. {seconds} s of prompt reading in total.
finding.rejected: {n} call(s) rejected: the prompt was larger than the loaded context.

detail.none: Click a row to see it here.

phase.prompt: Reading the prompt ({tokens} tokens not in the cache)

detail.break: The prompt stopped matching the previous call about {tokens} tokens in.
detail.noResult: No result in the next call.
detail.noAnswer: No answer kept for this call. Answers are kept from now on with Keep text on; this one was recorded before, and it ended a conversation, so it never came back in a later call.
detail.noText: Nothing kept for this call. Switch on Keep text on the Live page to see what each call sent and got back.
detail.emptyAnswer: (no text: the model only asked for tools)
detail.toolsMeasured: Measured from outside: the time between the model's answer and the agent's next call. The tools themselves are not traced; what they were asked and what they returned is read from the calls.
detail.agentOnly: The model asked for no tool: this is the agent's own time between two calls.

foot: A run is one tool's calls that follow each other within two minutes. Steps start where the tool begins a fresh conversation. Times inside a call are Ollama's own; tool time is the gap between calls.
